- DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models (arxiv:2402.03300)
- Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters (arxiv:2408.03314)
- Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models (arxiv:2201.11903)

## Where to look

1. Semantic Scholar recommendations with these seeds as positives (README section 6.2).
2. arXiv phrase queries from the target and the seeds' titles (6.1).

## Finish

`node build-corpus.mjs --merge`, then `node jobs.mjs check discover-0010 --live`, then `node jobs.mjs done discover-0010 --note "…"`.
